messages:
Ana R: Quick sync on landing copy for the three deployment pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private). Need a lightweight pass that ties launch posts + webinar CTA + inbound lead routing. Can we ship a cohesive hero + 2 supporting bullets per page by EOD tomorrow?

Devin L: Uploaded three hero variants to the doc. Hosted = 'fastest time-to-value', Dedicated = 'predictable throughput', Private = 'enterprise-grade data control'. Doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/launch-copy-v4 — highlights in the first section.

Sam K: Nice. Question: how do we surface the webinar on each page without being pushy? Idea: single-line banner with 'Join our launch webinar — pick Hosted/Dedicated/Private track' that wires into a 1-step registration that then prompts deployment interest. That reduces blockers.

Priya M: Love that. Also we need a 160-char benchmark blurb for social and the page micro-hero: short, link to appendix. Suggest: 'Deliver production LLM inference with consistent latency across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.' Shorter than 160? We can craft a 120-char variant for tweets.

Devin L: Draft micro-copy examples in the doc. For the benchmark line, we need an exact stat and a method note. Chris H can confirm numbers from the recent bench run. @Chris H, can you confirm '3–5x throughput at P95 vs vanilla endpoint' and give a link to the bench artifact?

Chris H: I'll pull the bench artifact and post the permalink in this thread by EOD. Note: the 3–5x depends on model family + batch config; I'll add a short parenthetical and a link to the microbenchmark.

Sam K: Routing rules for inbound leads from launch posts / webinar signups — propose sending webinar registrants -> nurture sequence, and any 'deployment interest' flag -> sales routing. Pseudo-config below:

```
# inbound routing pseudocode
if source in ["launch_post", "webinar_reg"]:
  tag = "launch-2026"
  if form.deployment_choice == "Private":
    route -> sales.enterprise
  elif form.deployment_choice == "Dedicated":
    route -> sales.dedicated-ops
  else:
    route -> growth-nurture
  if form.role in ["SRE","Platform"]:
    priority = high
  notify: #marketing-leads channel
```

Priya M: Can we add a hidden field on the registration form for 'traffic_source' (utm_campaign) so we can attribute conversion to each post? Also make the webinar RSVP CTA include a drop-down for deployment interest — one-click for the user.

Ana R: Good. Let's lock the hero language and CTA mapping table now. I've pasted a quick table into the doc under 'CTA mapping' — please edit in-line. We want the CTA copy to map to the routing above (Register -> choose track -> route).

Devin L: I'll update the page copy to include the banner CTA and a micro-FAQ entry: 'Which deployment is right for me?' with two bullets. Also adding a small badge 'Benchmarked for production' that links to Chris's artifact.

Chris H: Posted bench permalink: https://bench.internal/redwood/bench-4821 — added model/config details and a short caveat. Use this for the appendix and the micro-copy parenthetical: '(based on internal 48k token/day sim; see appendix)'.

Sam K: Webinar planning: propose two live slots (Americas + EMEA) and a single replay. We'll build launch posts pointing to the live + replay landing with explicit CTA variants. I'll draft the social post copy and a short narrative emphasizing cost/latency tradeoffs and the migration story.

Marketing Bot: Webinar created (ID 4821). Registration page: https://events.redwood/4821.

Ana R: Action items: 1) Devin — finalize hero + banner + CTA mapping (today). 2) Chris — confirm bench (done). 3) Sam — social + webinar narrative (PR tomorrow). 4) Priya — ensure form has utm+deployment field (today). We'll reconvene after edits in the doc. :thumbsup:

Devin L: Sounds good. I'll tag you when the copy is ready for a final read.

Priya M: I'll also draft a short inbound-playbook for SDRs that explains how to prioritize Private vs Dedicated signals.

Sam K: I'll add a short appendix snippet for 'Suggested 2-line tweet' and a 3-line LinkedIn blurb. Drop any wordsmith tweaks in the doc.

Ana R: Thanks team — shipping this cleanly will make the launch posts and webinar feel cohesive rather than disjoint.

(emoji reactions: Ana R :rocket:, Devin L :white_check_mark:, Chris H :mag:)
